priorSequence.name: build
priorSequence.summary: 26 TABs, all certified locally, console feature-complete on mock adapters. Preserved, not superseded.

completedTabs: TAB 00 — Baseline, remotes and the evidence ledger (locally complete; environmentally blocked)
TAB 02 — Authentication and session (complete; enrolment screen, refresh and the expiry warning deferred with recorded reasons)
TAB 03 — Authorization convergence (steps 1–7, 9 complete; step 8 needs a live API; 6 keys wait on TAB 04)

TAB 04 — The case collision (decision recorded as ADR 0044, accepted in principle pending MSWDO ratification; routes renamed; status vocabularies reconciled; continuing-involvement module outstanding)
currentObjective: TAB 05: every HTTP adapter calls a route the backend actually registers, with the parameters it accepts, mapping the payload it returns — verified against the running API. Begins with the authoritative 147-row mapping built from route:list and openapi.json.

measuredBaseline.note: Current measured state, refreshed each TAB. The TAB 00 starting figures (console 71/1437/20 checks, backend 906 tests) live in the evidence ledgers. These supersede the sweep's stated 889 tests / 262 routes / 173 admin routes — ledger finding L-01.

openOwnerActions: D-00-01: decide and record repository visibility for BOTH repositories (both currently public)
TAB 00 step 2: create private remote / protect main on both repositories
TAB 00 steps 4–7: provision PostgreSQL 18 + Redis + object storage + Mailpit, migrate on real Postgres, seed, stand up staging
TAB 14: appoint a Data Protection Officer — longest lead time in the document, start immediately
TAB 04: schedule the case-model working session with the MSWDO head, a social worker and an intake officer
TAB 19 runbook: enrol every existing staff account in MFA BEFORE cutover — since TAB 02 an unenrolled staff account signs in to an enrolment-only session.

TAB 04 ratification: run the working session (MSWDO head + social worker + intake officer) against ADR 0044 — it proposes Option A and supersede-not-merge, and the continuing-involvement module waits on it.

notes.sweepMachine: The sweep was run on a Windows machine (C:\Users\paulg, Desktop\Taytay_Rizal_LGUIDS_Backend). Work is now on macOS against fresh GitHub clones. F-14 (console has no remote) and F-25 (no PHP toolchain) were true there and are not true here.
notes.tab01Precondition: TAB 01 states its precondition as 'a running backend to observe, not merely a document to read'. No staging API exists and no Postgres runs on this machine; TAB 01 proceeds against the repository as the source of observed truth (route:list, openapi.json, conventions.md, config/cors.php, the real generators), and every acceptance criterion needing a live call is recorded as environmentally deferred.
notes.verifyCommand: npm run verify (console) / php -d memory_limit=1G vendor/bin/phpunit (backend)
notes.tab01: Closed D1, D3, D4, D5, D6, D8 plus F-08 and the pagination publication defect. D2 (admin/ namespace) and D7 (field casing) are TAB 05 by design. check:contract guards all seven rules, each mutation-tested.
notes.tab02Precondition: TAB 01 complete. TAB 02 needs a live API to prove sign-in end to end; none exists here, so the console-side flow, token holder and MFA screen are built and unit-tested, and every acceptance criterion requiring a live round-trip is recorded as environmentally deferred.
notes.tab02: Closed D3/F-07 console-side. Found and fixed L-04 (second factor was opt-in by enrolment; three existing tests asserted the bypass) and L-05 (token abilities assigned but never enforced anywhere). ADR 0043 records both plus why refresh is sequenced after TAB 13.
notes.tab03Precondition: TAB 02 complete. TAB 03 needs an authenticated /me response; none can be obtained without a running API, so the reconciliation table, the canonical vocabulary decision and the console move onto server-issued permissions proceed against the measured 61-key backend enum and 68-key console array, with live refusal tests deferred.
notes.tab03Progress: Steps 1-4 COMPLETE and committed (console 5faf09a): reconciliation table with a decision per row at docs/access/permission-reconciliation.md, convention decision, role mapping. Steps 5-9 NOT STARTED. L-06 found: console guards field visits with case.view and has no visit.* key; backend has visit.view/visit.manage. Six keys deferred to TAB 04 (case.* x5, resident.merge). Data scope open.
notes.tab03: Canonical vocabulary applied: 6 backend renames (no data migration needed — role→permission is code; report_exports.permission_context snapshots deliberately NOT rewritten), console renamed to match, visit.view/visit.manage added closing L-06, console now renders from GET /me permissions with fail-closed handling both directions, matrix regenerated (70x7), data scope already agreed. Step 8 (direct-call refusal tests) needs a live API. Backend does not yet gain the console fine-grained splits — those land with enforcement points in TAB 07.
notes.tab04Precondition: TAB 04 is a DECISION command: it needs a working session with the MSWDO head, a social worker and an intake officer, and the master command says explicitly it must not be resolved in code or by whichever side is easier to change. Six permission keys (case.* x5, resident.merge) and the whole of TAB 05 are blocked on it.
notes.tab04: Option A + supersede, ADR 0044 in both repos, accepted in principle pending MSWDO ratification. admin/cases -> admin/assistance-requests (30 routes) done as ADR 0007 conformance (F-23), safe under all 3 options; me/cases deliberately NOT renamed (shipped Flutter client, /api/v1 stable). L-07: case and assistance vocabularies overlap on exactly one state (assessment) — worse than none. Releases diverge 9v6, TAB 08 owns it. OUTSTANDING: continuing-involvement module, 6 permission keys, citizen-visible note projection.
notes.tab05Progress: Steps 1, 3, 5, 8, 9 COMPLETE. Step 1: port-mapping.md, 148 rows, 28 phantom routes caught and corrected; 66 clean / 46 transform / 36 no counterpart. Step 3: API_ENDPOINTS repointed (cases deliberately 404s). Step 5: optionalItem distinguishes 404 from transport failure. Step 8: WriteIntent adds Idempotency-Key per intent. Step 9: NotificationRepository.create deleted; local toasts built by toLocalNotification and marked read locally. REMAINING: steps 2/4/6/7/10 — per-resource snake_case mappers, adapter bodies rewritten in dependency order, money as integer centavos and ISO dates end to end, and adapter tests against RECORDED REAL RESPONSES, which needs a staging API that does not exist on this machine.
